# Intake Brief: `skill/audit/tests/test_budget_exceeded_resume.py` flaky in full-repo runs (test-order pollution)

**Headline:** Fix the test-order/environment pollution that makes the five audit budget/resume tests pass in isolation but fail in a varying subset during full-repo runs, so full-suite results are deterministic and trustworthy.

## Problem Statement

The audit budget/resume test module `skill/audit/tests/test_budget_exceeded_resume.py` is flaky when the
full repository test suite runs under load: all 5 tests in the file pass reliably in isolation and in a
standalone audit-suite run, but a *varying subset* fails during full-repo runs. The failures are a
symptom of test-order/environment pollution — shared process state or timing assumptions leak between
tests — so a "green" full-suite run cannot currently be trusted, and the flake blocks trustworthy
pre-release verification.

## Users & User Stories

- **Agent/operator:** "When I run the full test suite before a PR or release, I need the audit
  budget/resume tests to produce the same result every time, so that a green run actually means the code
  is correct."
- **Maintainer:** "When this module fails, I need a reproducible cause and a deterministic fix — not a
  re-run until it goes green — so the flake does not keep re-entering the triage queue."
- **Release manager:** "Because a varying subset of these tests fails intermittently, I cannot use the
  full-suite result as a reliable release gate."

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **Root cause identified and documented.** The specific shared-state leak(s) or timing assumption(s)
   causing the full-repo-only failures are pinpointed and recorded in this work item (the offending
   state/env var/module plus the mechanism by which it crosses test boundaries), validated by a
   reproduction that fails in the full-repo order and passes in isolation.
2. **Fix implemented — deterministic in full-repo runs.** All 5 tests in
   `skill/audit/tests/test_budget_exceeded_resume.py` pass deterministically across repeated full-repo
   runs: at least 5 consecutive `python3 skill/test/scripts/run_tests.py --scope full` (or the
   documented equivalent full-suite command) complete with zero failures in this file, and no assertions
   are weakened, no tests are skipped/xfailed, and no retry wrapper is used to mask the flake.
3. **Regression/validation coverage.** A test or documented reproduction harness demonstrates the fix:
   it reproduces the pollution (fails) against the pre-fix code and passes with the fix applied.
4. **Duplicate consolidated.** The sibling tracker `SA-0MU7KKKYF003GC2S` (same file, same root cause) is
   resolved as a duplicate of this item and its evidence is captured here.
5. **All related documentation is updated** to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and
   any relevant wiki or docs-site entries.
6. **Full project test suite must pass** with the new changes.

## Constraints

- **Do not change production semantics without evidence.** If the leak is caused by production code (for
  example `os.environ` mutation in `audit_runner.main` / `_apply_proxy_mode_serialization`, or module-level
  counters), prefer isolating it in tests; only change production behaviour when the investigation proves
  the production code is at fault.
- **Do not mask the flake.** Skipping, weakening assertions, adding retries, or serialising the whole suite
  is not an acceptable fix.
- **Limit blast radius.** Prefer changes scoped to the audit test suite; if a shared helper
  (`skill/shared/process_semaphore.py`, `skill/shared/queue.py`) is implicated, verify the full suite.
- **Reproducibility first.** A fix without a demonstrated reproduction is not acceptable.

## Existing State

- **Confirmed flaky in full-repo runs** (verified 2026-09-22, commit `2bb6529b`): the failing subset varies
  between runs. Observed failing tests: `TestBudgetExhaustionRecording::test_child_recorded_partial_and_checkpoint_written`,
  `TestBudgetExceededResume::test_resume_completes_budget_exceeded_child`,
  `TestBudgetExceededResume::test_resume_skips_completed_phases`.
- **Green in isolation:** `pytest skill/audit/tests/test_budget_exceeded_resume.py` → 5 passed;
  `pytest skill/audit/` → 964 passed, 2 skipped; node suites → 451 passed.
- **Not caused by the test-isolation guard** delivered in `SA-0MU8EKJYY007PT42` (different test file; that
  file passes 25/25 in isolation and in full runs).
- **Incident history:** this item was blocked by the destructive `init`-commit incident
  (`SA-0MU89WA740004GOJ`, now completed); the repository has been recovered to `origin/dev`. The flake is
  *not* caused by that incident and persisted after recovery.
- **Duplicate trackers:** `SA-0MUCI8H5Z002UT66` was deleted as a duplicate during full-suite verification;
  `SA-0MU7KKKYF003GC2S` is consolidated into this item (AC4).
- **Current stage:** plan was executed concurrently against the earlier, weaker ACs; this brief supersedes
  that description and scopes the item to fixing the root cause.

## Desired Change

Make the audit budget/resume tests deterministic and order-independent in full-repo runs by fixing the
underlying isolation defect (shared state, leaked environment, or timing assumption), backed by a
reproduction that fails before the fix and passes after it.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `skill/audit/tests/test_budget_exceeded_resume.py` — the flaky tests; the `_free_audit_slot` autouse
  fixture and `_Harness` mock clock/runner live here.
- `skill/audit/tests/conftest.py` — suite-wide autouse isolation fixtures (green-cache, child-in-main-slot,
  ownership resolution) — the right place for a shared isolation guard.
- `skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py` — module-level state and process-wide mutation:
  `_AUDIT_TICKET_COUNTER`, `_apply_proxy_mode_serialization()` (`os.environ` writes), the flock-based
  audit semaphore/queue, and parent-timeout resolution.
- `skill/audit/tests/wl_helpers.py` — `stateful_wl_side_effect`, the per-call worklog state model.
- `skill/audit/tests/test_audit_queue_integration.py` and `test_audit_queue_stale_tickets.py` — neighbouring
  tests that set `AUDIT_*` env vars and exercise real locks; primary order-pollution suspects.
- `skill/shared/process_semaphore.py` — flock semaphore used by `_acquire_audit_slot`; implicated only if
  the investigation points there.

## Related Work

- **SA-0MU7KKKYF003GC2S** — duplicate tracker for the sibling test in the same file; consolidated here (AC4).
- **SA-0MU89WA740004GOJ** — destructive `init`-commit recovery + test-isolation guard (completed); former
  blocker, now resolved.
- **SA-0MUA6PNI6000LZH8** — full project test-suite verification (completed); recorded the recurrence and
  isolation evidence for this flake.
- **SA-0MU9HRV80006BXZH** — parent timeout-guard flake (`test_default_guard_skips_child_in_pathological_run`).
- **SA-0MUA737PH0048RHS** / **SA-0MUBGF69N004C6ZH** — slot-aware concurrency flake
  (`test_dynamic_ceiling_caps_by_available_slots`).
- **SA-0MU33W0T3008FSD1** — origin regression test for budget exhaustion/checkpoint/resume (blocked).
- **SA-0MU8CD4V3002WL7N** — unrelated `test_plan_helpers.py` failure (completed).

## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **SA-0MSHZ08K8009WH9A** – Remove workflow-descriptor validators (completed)
- **SA-0MTHC710X003ORZM** – Audit staleness race: post-persist comment bumps updatedAt past auditedAt — passed audits show stale icon (completed)
- **SA-0MU8CD4V3002WL7N** – [test-failure] skill/plan/tests/test_plan_helpers.py::TestPlanApprovalReclaimInvariant (2 tests) — failing test (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py` — matched: acceptance, affects, agent, already, assign (+137 more)
- `docs/dev/audit-skill-reference.md` — matched: acceptance, affects, agent, already, assign (+125 more)
- `skill/audit/SKILL.md` — matched: acceptance, agent, already, assign, audit (+110 more)

## Risks & Assumptions

- **Assumption:** the full-repo-only failures are test-order/environment pollution, not a production logic
  bug — evidenced by consistent passes in isolation and in the standalone audit suite.
- **Risk — hard to reproduce deterministically.** The flake appears only under load in a multi-agent
  environment. *Mitigation:* reproduce by ordering the suspected polluting test(s) before this module, and
  use repeated full-suite runs to confirm the fix; document the reproduction command.
- **Risk — shared-helper blast radius.** If the leak originates in `skill/shared/process_semaphore.py` or
  `skill/shared/queue.py`, the fix may affect other suites. *Mitigation:* verify the full project suite and
  keep production changes minimal.
- **Risk — concurrent agents.** Multiple herdr agents operate on this repository concurrently and have
  already advanced/edited this item and its sibling; edits must be re-verified before implementation.
  *Mitigation:* re-read the item and re-run the full suite at implementation time.
- **Scope-creep risk:** other known flakes (`SA-0MU9HRV80006BXZH`, `SA-0MUA737PH0048RHS`,
  `SA-0MUBGF69N004C6ZH`) are separate work items and must not be folded into this one; capture any new
  discoveries as linked work items instead.

## Appendix: Clarifying Questions & Answers

- **Q:** Should this item fix the root cause of the test-order pollution, or be a verification-only /
  flaky-close item? — **A (operator, 2026-09-22):** Fix the root cause (option 1a). Source: interactive
  reply in session `herdr-1790114280-1503247-25905`.
- **Q:** Should the sibling tracker `SA-0MU7KKKYF003GC2S` (same file, same root cause) be consolidated into
  this item and closed as a duplicate, or kept separate? — **A (operator, 2026-09-22):** Consolidate under
  this item (option 2a). Source: interactive reply. Action taken: comment added to `SA-0MU7KKKYF003GC2S`
  and the item deleted as a duplicate.
- **Q:** Keep priority `critical` (test-failure triage default) or downgrade for a flake that passes in
  isolation with no production impact? — **A (operator, 2026-09-22):** Downgrade to `high` (option 3b).
  Source: interactive reply. Action taken: `wl update --priority high`.
- **Prior open questions from the 2026-09-19 plan stage** (now resolved): authorisation to reset the local
  checkout to `origin/dev` (recovery executed, `SA-0MU89WA740004GOJ` completed); ownership of the
  `_init_repo` fixture fix (delivered under `SA-0MU8EKJYY007PT42`); whether this item closes on
  verification (superseded — operator scoped it to a root-cause fix on 2026-09-22).
